# Third-party files

These are hosted here so Python Path works on networks that block outside script sites, and offline.

- `pyodide/`: [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org) 0.26.4 (Python compiled to WebAssembly). Mozilla Public License 2.0. Source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide
- `codemirror/`: [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net/5/) 5.65.16 code editor. MIT licence (see `codemirror/LICENSE`).
